boundaries.title: Safety & Ethical Commitments
boundaries.description: We prioritise your decision-making agency and psychological resilience throughout the transition.

items.question: Is immigration or legal advice provided?
items.answer: Coaching is not an immigration service. We work within your known constraints and signpost official resources, but do not provide legal representation or regulatory interpretation.

items.question: Are specific outcomes guaranteed?
items.answer: We do not provide placement guarantees. Our value lies in improving your market positioning and strategic decision-making. Final outcomes depend on market conditions and individual engagement.

items.question: Handling systemic barriers?
items.answer: We work on protective strategies and evidence-based recording of processes to ensure your professional safety remains a priority.

pricing.title: Service Investment

packages.name: Positioning Alignment (3 Sessions)
packages.scope: 3 × 50 minutes / CV & LinkedIn calibration / Initial outreach experiments.

packages.name: Market Momentum (6 Sessions)
packages.scope: 6 × 50 minutes / Portfolio reframing / Interview rehearsals focused on cultural fit.

policies: Confidentiality: Following ICF ethics and GDPR data minimisation practices.
Logistics: UK office hours (GMT/BST); Invoiced in GBP.
Scope: Evidence-led coaching; does not include done-for-you drafting or recruitment placement.

items.q: What is the primary language of sessions?
items.a: Sessions are delivered in English to align with workplace search requirements. However, we can use Chinese for nuanced conceptual alignment where necessary to ensure clarity of decision-making.

items.q: Will you contact recruiters on my behalf?
items.a: No. We assist in crafting authoritative outreach scripts and communication strategies, while you retain full agency over professional relationship management.
Please have your current CV and LinkedIn URL ready, along with two concrete examples of professional problem-solving or decision-making from your previous experience.

cases.title: Composite Case Studies
cases.description: Demonstrating localisation pathways; anonymised for confidentiality.

items.title: Strategic Communication for Sponsorship
items.context: Professional concerned about early-stage exclusion due to sponsorship requirements.
items.coaching_moves: Designed structured sponsorship messaging; prioritised firms based on historical data; established a 14-day output reflection cycle.
items.shift: Approached sponsorship inquiries with a neutral, professional stance, resulting in faster signals from target employers.

items.title: Translating Leadership for UK Leads
items.context: Senior manager concerned that international leadership experience was being undervalued by local hiring teams.
items.coaching_moves: Applied the CAR (Challenge-Action-Result) framework to key projects; integrated risk-management details; rehearsed senior-level stakeholder alignment.
items.shift: Interview feedback shifted from 'misalignment' to 'demonstrated professional value', improving depth of engagement in final rounds.
